continuity_scope: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, VIZ English manga Vol. 1 (paperback/digital; 9 November 2021; ISBN 978-1-9747-2576-2). This is a narrow official-metadata pass, not an anime, later-volume, guidebook, game, or full Japanese serialization pass.
work_or_witnesses: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, Vol. 1, VIZ English edition (9 November 2021)
coverage_rule: Include only named dramatic individuals directly named and described by the selected official Vol. 1 metadata. This yields Frieren. Her former comrades are not individually named in the selected metadata, so no other character records or relationships are inferred. Claims requiring the unexcerpted manga page/chapter text are deferred to a separately inspected primary-text pass.
omissions: All named former-party members, later companions, antagonists, demons, and other individuals are omitted because VIZ's selected Volume 1 metadata does not name/profile them.
The Japanese Shogakukan edition/serialization, all later volumes/chapters, anime adaptation, games, guidebooks, and other adaptations are separate witnesses.

Past-scene chronology beyond the official synopsis, detailed magic/spells, artifacts, places, explicit cause/manner of the funeral, grief arc, violence, and outcomes are omitted absent inspected primary-manga chapter locators.
uncertainties: VIZ metadata calls Frieren an elf mage and says she will long outlive her former party, but it does not provide a numerical lifespan, complete biology, or all historical chronology.

The available free VIZ chapter-reader page proves Chapter 1 availability but browser-accessible text/panel locators are not supplied; this pass therefore does not represent individual chapter panels or quote manga dialogue.
'Last wishes of her comrades' is plural official metadata wording without named counterpart(s), so it cannot support a named-character relationship record.
The record marks bereavement/loss and adventure violence as thematic/content cautions without reducing them to a generic genre equivalence.
evidence_basis: VIZ official English Volume 1 and series metadata only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, anime recap, secondary synopsis, or uninspected panels are used as evidence.
